description:
NEW PHOTOS COMING SOON - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this stunning, fully refurbished three bedroom house on Collingwood Road, Newbiggin-by-the-Sea. Currently undergoing its final stages of refurbishment, the property is expected to be completed within the next few weeks and will offer a fresh, modern living space throughout.

The property comprises three well proportioned bedrooms, a family bathroom, a convenient downstairs WC and a stunning open plan kitchen and dining area. With its stylish new finish and thoughtfully designed layout, this property is ideal for families and professionals alike.

Situated in a convenient location, the property is close to local schools, the beach, a variety of restaurants and bars, and excellent transport links, making it perfectly placed to enjoy everything Newbiggin-by-the-Sea has to offer.

With refurbishment works nearing completion, this is an exciting opportunity to secure a beautifully updated home.

Contact My Property Box today for further information or to register your interest!
